description: 'Ridgeline Glass & Glazing' on Summit; broken storefront lite

email.subject: Summit - BC-5004 storefront lite
email.body:
Hi,

A storefront lite at the Summit main entry was broken while your crew was setting the adjacent panel. We had the glass replaced.

BC-5004: replace broken storefront lite, main entry, $3,200.00.

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz
Project Manager, Apex Builders
